pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding contracts to a position experiencing negative floating drawdowns; pyramiding is limited to trades already in +$10.00 profit with trailing stops locked at breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory multi-timeframe ATR volatility check: no order execution allowed if current 5-minute candle range exceeds 2.5x the 20-period average true range without volume confirmation.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger partial profit closure (50%) at +$12.00 and initiate aggressive trailing stops to lock in a minimum +$6.00 floor on all runners targeting +$15.00 to +$30.00.
